counterexample: Tick spacing 10. One position [100, 200) with liquidity L, so ticks 100 (net +L) and 200 (net -L) are initialized. Start 100, end 50. The search still begins strictly below 100, so the walk returns nothing and the liquidity stays at L, while the active liquidity at tick 50 is 0. The walk should return [100].
summary: Adds a branch for a start tick that is a multiple of the spacing, but that branch does exactly what the other path does: load the start word and call _advanceToNextDown. The walk is unchanged and still skips an initialized start tick.
